import os

# Loop through all file paths
for file_path in file_paths:
    # Derive title from filename
    base = os.path.basename(file_path)
    name_without_ext = os.path.splitext(base)[0]
    title = name_without_ext.replace('_', ' ')
    
    # Skip if title already exists
    if title in existing_titles:
        print(f"Skipping existing: {title}")
        continue
    
    # Read file content
    file_data = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token)
    content = file_data['content']
    
    # Create note
    try:
        result = apis.simple_note.create_note(title=title, content=content, access_token=sn_token)
        note_id = result['note_id']
        existing_titles.add(title)
        print(f"Created note '{title}' (id {note_id})")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error creating '{title}': {e}")
        # If duplicate error, add to existing titles to skip later
        if 'already exists' in str(e):
            existing_titles.add(title)
